CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates), an organization/presentation (the full-coordinate listing and coordinate convention), and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the same identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries identify specific content items with attributes (red/blue) and explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/status metadata for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/processing provenance.

O.rationale: The report specifies how coordinates are presented (row/column convention) and shows organized coordinate listings for a referent.
